shell_kit._note: shared/shell (껍데기 키트): copies of already-vetted assets, built by tools/build_shell_kit.py; no new download.

tabler-icons.notes: inner SVG markup of each 24x24 icon; xmlns/class/bounding path removed

dicebear-thumbs.notes: unmodified files; metadata/xmlns stripped only when inlined

data_files._note: Vendored DATA files (not code, not inlined into pages). LICENSE files were read from the downloaded package.
